dmp.description:
The purpose of this Data Management Plan is to describe how data generated within the MROX HPC project will be handled, stored, and preserved. The project involves the simulation and analysis of high-resolution X-ray diffraction data using advanced computational models and Bayesian inference methods.

The DMP ensures that all data produced, including experimental diffraction datasets, simulation outputs, and derived structural parameters, are properly managed, documented, and stored in a secure and reproducible manner throughout the project lifecycle.
